requests.result: Official site fetched, but current response is a site-upgrade maintenance page; no viewer configuration or parcel endpoint was present.

Official notice states that citizens, legal persons, and organizations may use the Hubei government service site, Ezhou online service hall, app, or WeChat channel for cadastral-map visualization; it does not publish an anonymous GIS API.
Official implementation plan describes authenticated/identity-verified cadastral visualization and parcel query fields, but does not provide a public feature-service URL or anonymous response.
Anonymous GET returned an nginx default page (3492 bytes), not the advertised online cadastral viewer; no JavaScript/configuration/API route was available.

requests.error: Bounded anonymous GET timed out after 15 seconds; no retry with credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or TLS weakening was attempted.
The legacy URL was identified in an official 2020 notice but was not used for parcel retrieval; no safe public geometry response was retained.

registryBasis: The first-party municipal bureau and Ezhou Real Estate Registration Center publish notices describing Ezhou cadastral-map updating and public visualization/query procedures. This evidences a local registry/cadastre custodian, not an open parcel geometry API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ezhou municipal cadastral and real-estate-registration administration; official notices refer to cadastral maps and parcel-level visualization/query workflows.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous public parcel layer, feature-service schema, CRS, native parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was verified. Exact-point and citywide parcel coverage remain unknown.

technicalBlocker: The advertised Ezhou online service currently returns an nginx default page, while the linked Hubei GreatMap host timed out under bounded anonymous GET. Official documentation describes identity-verified or service-mediated cadastral visualization but publishes no anonymous feature endpoint; no TLS exception was used.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Hubei/Ezhou service has a separately routed or currently unavailable public map/API, and whether it can return safe parcel IDs and geometry without identity verification, remains unresolved. The zero geometry result is not evidence of citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may inspect a responsive documented first-party feature service, first confirming schema, CRS, native identity, and safe fields.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
